query: How does Atlas preserve retry order for delayed jobs?

candidates.text: Atlas retains the original enqueue timestamp when a delayed job is retried, then orders ready work by that timestamp.
candidates.title: Atlas retry ordering

candidates.text: The Atlas retry guide lists queue metrics but does not define how delayed jobs retain their relative order.
candidates.title: Atlas retry metrics

candidates.text: A superseded Atlas draft proposed assigning a new enqueue timestamp on every retry.
candidates.title: Superseded Atlas retry draft

query: What is the approved Atlas policy for offline satellite archive recovery?

candidates.text: Atlas documents ordinary archive recovery but has no approved decision concerning offline satellites.
candidates.title: Atlas archive recovery

candidates.text: The unrelated Lunar service has a satellite recovery policy that does not apply to Atlas.
candidates.title: Lunar satellite recovery

candidates.text: The Atlas contributor guide specifies names for queue integration tests.
candidates.title: Atlas contributor guide

query: When does Boreal stop promoting a canary release?

candidates.text: Boreal pauses canary promotion when the release exhausts its error budget in the first deployment zone.
candidates.title: Boreal canary policy

candidates.text: Boreal version one promoted after a fixed timer; that rule does not apply to the current release controller.
candidates.title: Boreal version-one rollout

candidates.text: Another product pauses regional replication after a storage quota alert, not a canary error budget.
candidates.title: Storage replication alert

query: What must Cinder verify before publishing a cache entry?

candidates.text: Cinder publishes a cache entry only after both payload and metadata checksums match the staged record.
candidates.title: Cinder cache publication

candidates.text: Cinder periodically records checksum latency but this dashboard note does not define publication requirements.
candidates.title: Cinder checksum dashboard

candidates.text: An obsolete Cinder experiment published after checking only the payload digest.
candidates.title: Obsolete Cinder experiment
